about: When a state's law schedules the special election for a vacancy, by office family. kind: days-after-vacancy (days, a nominal value inside the statutory window), weekday-after-days (the first given weekday, 0=Sunday, on or after the vacancy plus days: a writ within so many days and an election on a Tuesday so many days after it), next-general (no special election; the seat waits for the next general election, an appointee serving), unread (the estimate in parameters.json stands in: SG-GOV-special-election-timing). The method (special election, appointment, succession) is read from data/research/offices/state-offices.json by offices-state.ts; this table is only the date. Read by src/core2/elections-calendar.ts specialElectionDate.
